title: Congress leaders from Keralam urge AICC to restore consultations within party ahead of UDF’s policy decisions
description: K.C. Joseph, Benny Behanan, Shafi Parambil meet Mallikarjun Kharge, air grievances about a 'dormant' party apparatus stemming from the lack of a full-time State president and delayed reorganisation. Their demands include a hands-on party president
